records.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro intake record (intake.md), the status history (status_history.md) and the Snowflake extract (extract.csv). The amount, dates, vehicle and policy fields agree across all three, and the Collision checklist is complete: notice of loss, loss description, vehicle identification, one damage photo and the body shop's repair estimate (repair_estimate.md). intake.md and extract.csv both show the policy period ending 2025-10-31, and the date of loss is 2025-11-12. The intake system flagged this coverage gap when the claim was received, and it is recorded as a policy lapse indicator. No renewal, reinstatement or grace-period record is on file. The estimate and photo contents were not reviewed because the rules for a complete E-Portal claim did not call for it. Because the record is complete and internally consistent, the claim is routed for an adjuster to make the coverage decision in ClaimsPro.
